staff.signin.title: Sign in to the staff console
staff.signin.failed: The e-mail or password is not right, or this account cannot sign in.
staff.signin.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
staff.signin.ticket_ended: That took too long. Please start again with your e-mail and password.
staff.signin.code_hint: The 6-digit code your authenticator app shows for TrustBazaar staff.
staff.signin.code_failed: The code is not right. Use the newest code from your app.
staff.enrol.explain: Your account is new or was reset. Choose your own password, then add the console to an authenticator app.
staff.enrol.password_hint: At least {min} characters, not the one you were given. A few unrelated words work well.
staff.enrol.add_app: Add TrustBazaar staff to your authenticator app with this key, or open the link on this device.
staff.enrol.code_hint: The 6-digit code the app now shows, to confirm it is set up.
staff.password.common: This password is too common. Choose another.
staff.password.context: Do not use your name or e-mail in the password.
staff.password.unchanged: Choose a password other than the one you were given.
staff.session.idle: You will be signed out in {left} because nothing has been done for a while.
staff.session.absolute: Your console session ends at {at} (the 8-hour limit). Finish what you are doing; you will sign in again.
staff.session.refresh_failed: Your session could not be extended. Save your work; you may be signed out soon.
staff.queues.title: Queues
staff.queue.order: Oldest first; overdue items are on top.
staff.queue.empty: Nothing is waiting in this queue.
staff.queue.not_yet: This queue is not available yet.
staff.item.payout: A new bank payout account to check
staff.claim.conflict-of-interest: You cannot take this case: you have a conflict of interest with someone in it. Another operator will take it.
staff.claim.already-claimed: Another operator has already claimed this case.
staff.approvals.title: Approvals
staff.approvals.explain: Actions another staff member proposed that need a second person of your role. Your own proposals are not shown here.
staff.approvals.none: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
staff.approvals.approve_consequence: The action runs now and is recorded in the audit log with your name.
staff.approvals.reject_consequence: Nothing is done, and the proposal is closed. This is recorded in the audit log.
staff.approval.disclosure.approve: Disclose data on a lawful request
staff.action.reason_hint: Required, at least {min} characters. It is kept in the audit log.
staff.action.reason_short: Write a reason of at least {min} characters.
staff.case.links_expire: Files open by links that expire after a few minutes; each view is recorded.
staff.case.not_open: This case is no longer open in its queue.
staff.refusal.not-claimed: Claim this case in its queue first; only the operator who claimed it can open it.
staff.refusal.conflict-of-interest: You have a conflict of interest with someone in this case; another operator must handle it.
staff.refusal.already-claimed: Another operator has already claimed this case.
staff.refusal.feature-off: This is switched off for now.
staff.refusal.listing-state: The listing has changed meanwhile; reload the page.
staff.refusal.kyc-cannot-approve: This submission cannot be approved (for example, the person is under 18 or the identity is blacklisted).
staff.refusal.between-zero-and-item-pric: A partial refund must be more than zero and less than the item price.
staff.refusal.partial-refund-only: An amount is only for a partial refund.
staff.refusal.not-for-this-item: This outcome is not possible for this item.
staff.refusal.live-check-not-matched: A proof whose live check did not match cannot be approved.
staff.refusal.use-the-ownership-review: A game account is approved through its ownership proof.
staff.refusal.out-of-range: A partial refund must be more than zero and less than the item price.
staff.dispute.title: Dispute {ref}
staff.dispute.four_eyes: This decision needs a second operator's approval.
staff.dispute.game_no_credentials: The login details are never shown: only the handover's record.
staff.dispute.context: Earlier disputes of these members: {disputes}. Strikes: {strikes}. Sanctions: {sanctions}.
staff.dispute.request_consequence: The seller is told and has 24 hours to answer; the review pauses until then.
staff.outcome.release: Release the payment to the seller
staff.outcome.partial_refund: Refund part of the item price
staff.outcome.refund_after_return: Refund after the item is returned
staff.dispute.amount: Refund of the item price (at most {max})
staff.dispute.amount_invalid: Enter an amount in taka, such as 1,500.
staff.dispute.return_payer: Who pays to send the item back
staff.dispute.split: The buyer gets back {refunded}; the seller is paid {payout}.
staff.dispute.decide_incomplete: Choose the outcome; for a partial refund, show the split of the amount first; for a return, say who pays.
staff.dispute.decide_consequence: The money moves now as shown, the decision is final, and both members are told.
staff.dispute.decided: Decided. The money has moved and both members are told.
staff.dispute.proposed: Proposed. A second operator must approve it under Approvals.
staff.dispute.pack_explain: One PDF of the case with a list of file hashes, for law enforcement. Making it is recorded.
staff.dispute.pack_hash: SHA-256 {hash}…, {files} files; the link works until {at}
staff.report.title: Report {ref}
staff.report.resolve_consequence: The report is closed with this resolution.
staff.signal.title: Flagged activity {ref}
staff.signal.review_consequence: The flag is closed with this note.
staff.signal.cancel_consequence: The auction ends without a winner and every bidder is told. This cannot be undone.
staff.signal.issue_consequence: The issue is closed with this reason.
staff.member.title: The member {ref}
staff.member.until_hint: The end of that day, Dhaka time.
staff.member.sanction_consequence: The sanction takes effect now and the member is told.
staff.member.sanction_incomplete: Choose a sanction and, if given, an end date in the future.
staff.member.blacklist_title: Propose adding the identity to the NID blacklist
staff.member.four_eyes_consequence: Nothing happens until a second operator approves it under Approvals.
staff.member.proposed: Proposed. A second operator must approve it.
staff.member.conflict_consequence: You will not be able to take or act on cases involving this member; another operator will.
staff.kyc.title: KYC submission {ref}
staff.kyc.audited: Opening this submission is recorded in the audit log.
staff.kyc.name: Full name
staff.kyc.files_explain: Each image opens only after you say why; the reason is recorded with the view.
staff.kyc.why: Why you need to see the {file}
staff.kyc.reason.selfie_mismatch: The selfie does not match the document
staff.kyc.reason.details_mismatch: The details do not match the document
staff.kyc.incomplete: Choose approve, or reject with a reason.
staff.kyc.approve_consequence: The member becomes verified and is told.
staff.kyc.reject_consequence: The member is told the reason and may submit again.
staff.listing.title: Listing {ref}
staff.listing.use_proof: A game account is reviewed through its ownership proof:
staff.listing.return_consequence: The listing goes back to a draft and the seller is told your reason.
staff.listing.remove_consequence: The listing is removed for good, an open auction on it is cancelled, and the seller and bidders are told.
staff.proof.title: Ownership proof {ref}
staff.proof.live: Your own check in the game
staff.proof.live.matched: The code shows on that player ID
staff.proof.live.not_available: I could not check in the game
staff.proof.incomplete: Record your own check and the decision.
staff.proof.approve_consequence: The seller's claim to this player ID is recorded and the listing is published.
staff.proof.reject_consequence: The listing goes back to a draft and the seller is told your reason.
staff.payout.title: Bank payout account {ref}
staff.payout.explain: Approve only if the account is in the member's verified legal name. Reading the legal name is recorded.
staff.payout.approve_consequence: Payouts go to this account after its cooling-off period; the member is told.
staff.payout.reject_consequence: The account is not used and the member is told your reason.
staff.payout.approved: Approved. It takes effect after the cooling-off period.
